opening.argument: The speaker invites viewers to register, buy initial platforms for 0.05 ETH, and pay gas through a MetaMask or Trust Wallet connection. He presents a down-line structure in which invited participants generate commissions and partner platform openings provide payments, stating, “When you invite people, you get a small commission from their contribution.” The program requires sequential purchases across ETH-priced levels, ranging from 0.025 ETH to 51.2 ETH, while instructing viewers to “Share this link and create a structure to earn many many ethers.” Its X3 and X4 diagrams reinforce the tiered matrix structure, and the description invites viewers to join a down-line to earn more. Claims of decentralization, transparency, and no unforeseen scam, together with a closing risk reminder, do not remove the invitation to pay ETH and recruit for promised crypto earnings.

citations.quote: To take part in F4SH, you need to register and buy the very first platforms. This costs 0.05 ETH or about $10 for the current course.
When you invite people, you get a small commission from their contribution.
They are different in price starting from 0.025 ETH, then 0.05 ETH, 0.1 ETH, 0.2 ETH and so on to the last one of 51.2 ETH.
Share this link and create a structure to earn many many ethers.
